title: Chapter 285 Peak Of The Immortal Emperor
content:
Chapter 285 Peak Of The Immortal Emperor

"Perfect?"

Chu Lingsheng looked up and saw a muscular man walking towards him.

The 24th list of monsters!

Man Cheng is even called a human-shaped beast by countless people, and his strength is comparable to that of ancient creatures.

In the academy, because of my own way of practicing, I basically have no friends, and Man Cheng is one of them.

"When did you come back?"

Chu Lingsheng asked.

Upon hearing this, Man Cheng smiled, "It's not long after he came back. I heard that some amazing guys have appeared in the academy. I feel itchy when I hear it."

What is a man of nature refers to Ao Qing and Lu Xue.

Especially Ao Qing, it is a nine-clawed extreme dragon, which is even more terrifying than ancient creatures.

Man Cheng is naturally very interested in competing.

Looking at Man Cheng's smiling expression, Chu Lingsheng immediately guessed Man Cheng's idea.

"Mancheng, that nine-clawed dragon is only in the early stage of the Immortal Saint Realm. With your strength, even if you descend, you probably will beat it into meat sauce with one punch."

Hearing this, Man Cheng was slightly stunned and scratched his head, "It seems to be, too,"

He is now at the second level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, at the same level. Because his physical strength is too perverted, he basically has few opponents.

Even if it is the Nine-Clawed Dragon, it will never be able to do anything to him.

Not only do Man Cheng and Chu Lingsheng think so, but basically everyone in the fairy world will think so.

"What about that Lu Xue? Isn't she the master of the Nine-Clawed Dragon?"

Man Cheng thought of Lu Xue, then looked at Chu Lingsheng and asked.

Hearing the name Lu Xue, Chu Lingsheng shook his head with a little disappointed, "It's just a guy who only has the tenth strength of the martial arts list. Her relationship with the Nine-Clawed Dragon may be just a cover-up."

"Of course, these are just my guess."

Chu Lingsheng seemed to be muttering to himself, but after hearing this, Man Cheng felt a little confused.

But he understood one thing, that was that Lu Xue didn't seem to be very good.

"It seems that the academy still depends on us."

Fortunately, Chu Lingsheng's words did not spread. If Ao Qing heard them, he would be anxious.

I have been blessed for eight lifetimes and tied to the little master, but to you, Is it a concealment? ? ?

"By the way, do you think those guys will come back?"

At this time, Man Cheng suddenly said.

As soon as these words came out, Chu Lingsheng's eyes suddenly became sharp.

After pondering for a long time, Chu Lingsheng said slightly, "They are likely not going to come back. That kind of place can't be found just by thinking about it."

At the same time, the crowd in the square has basically scattered.

Lu Xue's achievements were popular in the academy for a while, and then quickly subsided.

Tenth in the martial arts list, this score is very good, but not many are amazing.

If Lu Xue can directly enter the top three, or directly first, then Lu Xue's name will inevitably fail to dissipate in the academy for a long time.

Even beyond the academy, the entire fairy world is not inferior to that.

After all, the students in the academy all have their own identities outside.

Therefore, the spread of news from Tiandi Academy is definitely fast.

"We go back to Zhuyun Peak."

Lu Xue didn't say much, but directly took Ao Qing and Xiao Luo back to Zhuyun Peak.

And Qin Feng naturally followed suit and went back together.

On the spot, several students who had not left looked at the backs of Lu Xue and others leaving, shook their heads slightly, "I didn't expect that I would miss the situation."

"Yes, I thought this girl could make it into the top few."

Several people were more or less moved.

Only Xu Zijing remained silent.

"Brother, don't you want to say anything?"

A man suddenly looked at Xu Zijing and said.

Upon hearing this, Xu Zijing smiled slightly, "Tenth, it's really good."

Everyone:...

In the end, these people left.

Xu Zijing stood there, still looking at the direction of Lu Xue leaving, murmured, "You can also hide your strength in the martial arts tower. Miss Lu, you are really secrets all over your body."

Inside the peak of the cloud.

"My master, why did you quit when you hit tenth?"

As soon as Ao Qing came back, he looked at Lu Xue and asked.

He is only tenth in the martial arts list when Lu Xue is strong, and he doesn't believe it if he kills him.

Xiao Luo and the others also looked at Lu Xue, and they were also confused.

It shouldn't be.

Looking at the few people, Lu Xue shook her head slightly, "It's not the time to show her strength. I don't want to be paid attention to by everyone if I don't even have the Immortal Saint Realm."

"At that time, it may cause unnecessary trouble."

Lu Xue's voice was very faint, but the few people were a little shocked when they heard it.

Especially Ao Qing.

This is what the little master’s mind can think of?

"Xiao, little master, you won't be taken over, right?"

Bang!

As soon as he finished speaking, a loud slap slapped Ao Qing on the head.

"What do you mean!?"

Lu Xue's face turned slightly red and she was a little angry.

I am also very smart, but I am a little casual because of my previous family background.

Now that my dad and the others are gone, no one will give her any more protection, so I have to be more careful.

Ao Qing covered her head with a feeling of grievance.

Then I was so arrogant before, I wouldn’t have a bad thing, right?

After glanced at Lu Xue carefully, Ao Qing quickly lowered her head again.

Lu Xue naturally noticed Ao Qing's small movements, and her heart suddenly skipped a beat.

The next moment, Lu Xue lifted Ao Qing up with one hand.

He snorted coldly, "Say! What good things have you done?"

Obviously, Lu Xue didn't know about Ao Qing's challenge to Ye Yan's place. After all, she was still in the martial arts tower at that time and knew nothing about everything outside.

When Ao Qing heard Lu Xuedi's questioning, he felt guilty and stuttered, but he couldn't understand it.

Seeing this, Lu Xue turned to look at Xiao Luo and the others.

"Tell me, what's the stupid dragon doing while I'm away."

Seeing Lu Xue ask a question, Xiao Luo and the others naturally dare not hide it. Then they said in their hearts, "I'm sorry, Brother Qing."

Then he ignored Ao Qing's threatening gaze and said, "Sister Xue, Ao Qing challenged a powerful man on the list when you were on the list."

Qin Feng echoed on the side, "Haha, nothing is wrong, it's just that the same level crushed the other party."

Crushing at the same level.

Click-

Lu Xue clenched her fists tightly, her face looking a little ugly.

After a moment of silence, Lu Xue sighed, "Forget it."

Looking up at the sky, a trace of confusion appeared in Lu Xue's eyes, but it was fleeting.

It's just ten years, and it's still far from what my father said.

Now, it took me only ten years to reach the peak of the Immortal Lord Realm, only one step away from the Immortal Saint Realm.

Although I don’t know how strong the enemy is, what can I do? I have to cultivate to the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm.

Three hundred thousand years, probably it's OK.

By the way, Xiao Yin has practiced so fast, there must be some way. When Xiao Yin comes back, he can still ask for advice.

Practicing step by step is always not possible.
